Set the Constants of a Statically Started Filter From Its Static Model

Source: R/spec.R
static_filter_restart.Rd

Reads the predictor of the static model at the first row of each group of a statically started filter and stores it, with the model, on the term; for a joint filter it does so for each member, on that member's parameter.

Usage

static_filter_restart(tm, param, fit_s, newdata)

Arguments

tm

A model term; any term other than a statically started filter is returned unchanged.

param

The distribution parameter in whose equation the term sits.

fit_s

The fitted static model.

newdata

NULL for the fitting rows, or the rows on which the term was rebuilt.

Value

The term.
